summary: PR-1231 adds `payments.fx_rate`, which calls a new treasury FX service over plaintext http (`http://fx.fernbrook.example/rates`). It does so by reaching into `outbound._transport` instead of going through the inventoried integrations list. This violates ENC-2 (outbound integrations must use TLS) and INV-1 (outbound integrations must be inventoried with an owner and classification). No exception in the register covers either deviation. Process records (ticket, independent approval on head, CI on head) are in order, but the product violations require rejection.
